strokes.text: Manages one group inside a scene: the group itself and its placement in that scene.
obs-websocket cannot create a group, so the provider creates it through the native bridge plugin.
Fill the group with @resources/group_source or @resources/group_input, or manage a group and its children together with @resources/group_graph.
Group resources need the native bridge plugin loaded in OBS; see @guides/groups.
Import by collection name, scene UUID, group UUID and the scene item ID of the group, separated by pipe characters:

glazes.group_uuid: UUID that OBS assigned to the group. Children and filters refer to the group by it.
glazes.item_id: Scene item ID of the group in its scene. Reference it from `item_ids` of @resources/scene_contents and from `group_item_id` of group children.
glazes.name: Name of the group as shown in OBS. Changing it replaces the resource.
glazes.placement: Visibility, lock state, order and transform of the group in its scene.
